title: Waitlist from a cold list
bring: Waitlist export with one row per sign-up
pass_hint: at least 15 of the 300 sign up (5%)
how: Email 300 people who fit your target customer and don't know you, and invite them to join a waitlist.

title: Paid pre-sale at list price
bring: Checkout export showing payer count and price
how: Offer 10 likely buyers the product at full price, paid now, before it is built.

title: One paid channel test
bring: Ad or outreach export with spend, clicks and sign-ups
pass_hint: each sign-up costs less than you planned to spend to win a customer
how: Spend about $50 on one ad or outreach channel that sends people to a sign-up page.

title: Priced landing page
bring: Analytics export of visitors and buy-button clicks for a page that shows the price
pass_hint: at least 3% of visitors click Buy
how: Put up a one-page site that describes the product, shows the price and has a Buy button, then send at least 500 visitors to it.

title: Paid pilot invoice
bring: A paid invoice at the intended price
pass_hint: the customer pays the full price
how: Sell a paid pilot to one customer and invoice them at your intended price.

title: Signed letter of intent
bring: A letter of intent signed by a qualified buyer
how: Ask likely buyers to sign a short letter saying they intend to buy at your planned price.

title: Supplier letter of intent
bring: A letter of intent signed by a supplier
how: Ask suppliers to sign a short letter saying they will supply or list through you.

title: Repeat purchase cohort
bring: Orders export showing customers who bought twice
pass_hint: at least 30% of first buyers buy again
how: Track whether your first buyers come back and buy a second time.

title: Working prototype run
bring: A write-up of the prototype doing the core job end to end
pass_hint: it does the core job on that real input
how: Build a rough prototype and run one real customer's input through it from start to finish.

title: Unit economics model
bring: A model with each cost line and its source
pass_hint: each sale makes a profit at the tested price
how: Build a spreadsheet of every cost per sale, with a source for each number.

title: Delivery hours log
bring: Hours per engagement, or a handoff record
pass_hint: the work fits the planned hours without you doing it
how: Log the hours each customer job takes, or hand one job to someone else and record how it went.

title: Compliance or professional memo
bring: A memo naming the rule, the path and its cost
pass_hint: there is a clear way to comply, with a known cost and time
how: Get a short written answer from a lawyer or expert on which rules apply and what complying costs.
